data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 彩海学园天台的雪霞狼夕照
data.description: 放学后的彩海学园天台铁丝网旁，金红晚霞将弦神岛的近未来建筑群染成一片壮丽。雪菜身穿藏青色水手服校服，手中握着展开的七式突击降魔机枪“雪霞狼”。微风拂动她的水手服领巾与黑色长发，少女挺拔而立，回首望来的眼神坚定而温存，郑重立下作为剑巫永生守护的誓约。
data.action: standing on high school rooftop against brilliant sunset, sailor uniform, holding silver holy spear Schneeerbe, wind fluttering skirt and hair, resolute yet loving gaze
data.location: school rooftop with wire fence overlooking futuristic island city at sunset
data.lighting: glorious golden-orange sunset rays casting brilliant rim light on spear and uniform
data.mood: resolute warrior devotion, heroic youth nostalgia
data.promptProse: Standing on the school rooftop against a blazing orange sunset, Yukina holds her silver spear Schneeerbe in her sailor uniform. The wind flutters her dark hair as she looks back with resolute, tender devotion.
data.animaCaption: Yukina standing on a rooftop at sunset in her sailor uniform, holding her holy spear.
